Quantum 1.10.1 was certified on 2026-08-16. It pins **nucleus v1.6.2**, **quark v1.4.1** and **orbit v1.5.3**.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.10.0: nucleus goes from v1.6.0 to v1.6.2 (patch), quark goes from v1.4.0 to v1.4.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.5.1 to v1.5.3 (patch).
